events.title: H2O open house
events.description:
Description


A trip for club members and the public to TVS’s dark observing site. Meet at the corner of Mines and Tesla Roads. The caravan to the site leaves at 6:00 pm sharp. Bring $3 for site admission.  This is also an opportunity for members who want access but have not completed site orientation to do so.
